instruction: Inspect the repository fixture and write reconciliation.json. The output must contain exactly current_entrypoint, items, and safe_next_action. items must be a JSON object keyed by these four exact references from the stale/current guidance: branch:feature/legacy-retry, pull_request:7, local_worktree:C:\\work\\project, and release. Each item must contain exactly state and evidence_ref. evidence_ref must be an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into observable/state.json, written as observable/state.json#<pointer>. Derive the states from observable evidence: prefer terminal/current evidence over stale execution guidance; preserve unobservable local state as LOCALITY_REQUIRED rather than guessing; preserve an explicit HUMAN_GATE only when observable state requires it. Do not modify any source document.
